messages:
Erin: heads-up — seeing embeddings-scoped API keys successfully calling /v1/chat.generate in prod. Small but noticeable spike, ~120 requests in the last hour. authz service returned ALLOW via a fallback path.
Carlos: wtf, embeddings keys should be blocked from chat endpoints. Any clue on the fallback?
Erin: initial triage: when we rotated some KMS-wrapped keys last night the authz metadata cache keyed on `wrapped_key_id` got stale. authz tries a metadata lookup, fails, then applies a legacy route-compat allowlist for backward compatibility which incorrectly treats `embeddings:*` as compatible with chat in one edge case.
Jun: do we have an example authz decision from the log?
Erin: yes — from audit_logs:
```
{"api_key_id":"ak_XXX","route":"/v1/chat.generate","scope":"embeddings","decision":"ALLOW (fallback - metadata missing)"}
```
Carlos: that fallback should be DENY by default. We added the allowlist years ago for old SDKs but this is unsafe if metadata is missing.
Maya: can we query how many distinct api_key_ids hit chat with embeddings scope? I'll run a BigQuery over audit exports.
Erin: q used: `SELECT api_key_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM audit_logs WHERE route='/v1/chat.generate' AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) GROUP BY api_key_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 200;` — returns 17 keys, top 3 are rotated last night.
Jun: immediate mitigation: 1) invalidate authz metadata cache for affected keys 2) push hotfix to change fallback to explicit DENY 3) rotate the three suspect API keys again to ensure new metadata maps cleanly.
Carlos: how do we flush the cache? We have `authzctl` in prod: `authzctl flush-key-cache --key ak_XXX` correct?
Jun: yes; running flush now on the 3 keys. Doing parallel invalidation across replicas, then verify decision logs.
Erin: rolling flush done for the three keys — watching logs now. Also flagged a feature flag `authz.allowlist-legacy-fallback` and toggled to false as temporary stopgap.
sec-oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0453 in #incidents. Pager duty alerted.
Maya: for the hotfix I'll open a PR to change fallback behavior and add a unit test for missing metadata -> DENY. Also adding an integration test that simulates KMS wrapped key rotation (change wrapped_key_id) and verifies authz lookup path.
Carlos: long-term we should make the cache key invariant across KMS-wrapped rotations (store mapping from api_key_id -> scope, invalidated only when key policy actually changes). Jun, can infra help with a more tolerant cache key?
Jun: yes — plan: cache indexed by api_key_id + metadata_version. Rotation will bump metadata_version; if missing, treat as stale and force re-fetch instead of falling back. I'll draft an RFC and a migration plan.
Erin: also need audit & forensics: list all routes allowed via fallback in last 30 days — add to postmortem. I already exported `SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE decision LIKE '%fallback%' AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY);`
Carlos: owners/action items: Jun = cache fix RFC + infra changes, Maya = patch + tests + PR, Erin = forensics + incident notes + coordinate key re-rotations, Carlos = follow-up with product about deprecating legacy allowlist.
Maya: adding test case to the CI matrix to simulate KMS rotations and authz cache miss.
Jun: prod patch tomorrow during low traffic window, will include a feature-flagged rollout and health checks.
Erin: thanks. small ask — if anyone sees other odd authz fallbacks ping @Erin and post here. :pray: :lock:
Carlos: noted. Thanks Erin + Jun.
sec-oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress, next update in 30m.
